observedScenarios.observation: A real PNG fixture produced a candidate with controlled phone classification, revision 1, measured 320x240 canvas, generated thumbnail, immutable revisioned files and byte-matching SHA-256 values; a changed candidate became revision 2.

Missing rights, unknown category, reference-only byte reuse, invalid explicit asset ID, damaged PNG and an immutable-path byte conflict were rejected. Testing manifest and workflow state remained byte-identical and the conflicting existing file was not overwritten.

Visual and release approvals rejected missing human confirmation and wrong hashes. Valid records bound the exact asset, revision, candidate or item digest and current QA report digest. A modified item made QA stale and blocked promotion.

A production immutable-path conflict failed before manifest commit and left the old production manifest byte-identical. After removing the conflict, promotion copied the asset, QA and release records, incremented the catalog version and reported PROMOTED.
Status inspection detects digest drift as BLOCKED, and contract verification rejects an externally publishable policy or any frozen source digest drift.

limitations: Fixtures exercise real local files and catalogs but are not a user-approved final mockup.
SCN-011 requires a separate new-conversation recovery observation before acceptance.
